1 week (one mission per day, 30–60 min each)

{npc:Rashid}, the travelling merchant, is looking for experienced traders to buy goods from. To prove you are worthy, you do one task per day for a whole week, from Monday to Sunday, in different cities. At the end you can sell him items on any day and you get the achievement Recognised Trader.
On Sunday, in Carlin, after all the week's tasks: {npc:Rashid} declares you a Recognised Trader.
